## Problem

What part of the sample-generation or export workflow is difficult today?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the controls, preset, preview, render, inspection, or pack-export behavior from the user's point of view.

## Determinism and compatibility

Explain how fixed inputs and seeds behave, whether output bytes or manifests change, and whether an opt-in flag or schema version is required.

## Boundaries

Explain how the proposal remains offline, does not become a DAW or audio-device host, and preserves bounded file handling.

## Acceptance checks

List reproducible parameter sets, fixtures, and observable results that would demonstrate completion.
